proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q r hab hr
  have hN : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    by_cases ha₀ : a = 0
    · have hb₀ : b ≠ 0 := fun hb₀ => hab ⟨ha₀, hb₀⟩
      positivity
    · positivity
  have hd : |a * p + b * q + c| / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ r ↔ (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN), ← sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity), sq_abs, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hN.le]
  rw [hd]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hl, hc⟩
    have hw : a * p + b * q + c = a * (p - x) + b * (q - y) := by linear_combination hl
    rw [hw, ← hc]
    linarith [sq_nonneg (a * (q - y) - b * (p - x))]
  · intro h
    have hE : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 := by linarith
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K : ℝ, K ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - (a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 := ⟨_, Real.sq_sqrt hE⟩
    refine ⟨p - (a * (a * p + b * q + c) + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), q - (b * (a * p + b * q + c) - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · field_simp; ring
    · have : (p - (a * (a * p + b * q + c) + b * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - p) ^ 2 + (q - (b * (a * p + b * q + c) - a * K) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) - q) ^ 2 = ((a * p + b * q + c) ^ 2 + K ^ 2) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        field_simp; ring
      rw [this, hK]
      field_simp; ring
